text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a day out, Inari One and I are
headed back
to the academy when...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. People are lining out the door for
this
ramen shop today too?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
It's gotten pretty popular. Guess we'll
just have to
join the queue. My stomach
won't settle for
anything less.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oguri mentioned that ramen shop over
there
bein' real good a while back, and
I've been kinda
wantin' to check it out.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But ya know, I'm not really a fan of
standin'
'round, waitin' patiently in line!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, I'd hate to ignore her

recommendation, so I'm ponderin' what I
should
do.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
choice_data_list: じゃあ一緒に並んでみるか？
じゃあ一緒に並んでみる？
choice_data_list_en: Then want to try lining up together?
Then should we line up together?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right!
choice_data_list: 話している間に列が進むかなって
choice_data_list_en: I thought the line would move faster while we chatted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Inari One and I are waiting in line,
the topic
I bring up is...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I know we're in line for ramen and all,
but my fave
food is probably soba!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I could eat it every day! Actually, I
learned a
thing or two 'bout makin' it
back in my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I might not be great in the kitchen, but
when it
comes to soba, I can hold my
own!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, well I'm not a pro or anythin'. Mine
can't
compare to a proper restaurant's.
choice_data_list: 自分で作れるのはすごいな！
自分で作れるのはすごいね！
choice_data_list_en: It's impressive that you can make this yourself!
It's really impressive that you can make this yourself!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're a curious one! And that
makes me
wanna deliver!
choice_data_list: ちょっと食べてみたいかも……
choice_data_list_en: I kind of want to try a bite...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll make some for ya next time then. Be
prepared
for a flavor explosion!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what's your preference when
it comes
to soba noodles, Boss? Gimme
a li'l hint for
reference!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what's your preference when
it comes
to soba noodles, Boss? Gimme
a li'l hint for
reference!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before we know it, Inari One and I are in
deep
conversation about soba.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you two waiting! This way,
please!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's already our turn?! Time just
flew by!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to quit thinkin' 'bout soba
and
focus on the ramen!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spending the day standing in line
together, I can't
help but feel the
distance between me and Inari
One has
shrunk a little.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me, the sauna at the
bathhouse I
usually go to is bein' fixed
right now. It's super
annoyin'.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
'Course I do! Takin' a hot bath is nice,
but so are
saunas! Plus, there's a
particular way to enjoy 'em.
choice_data_list_en: You really like saunas, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya gotta follow all the right steps and
then savor
every moment... Before ya
know it, you'll be in
heaven!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, great idea! I'll give ya some
sauna
recommendations later! It's even
better after a
hard day's work!
choice_data_list: ……なんかサウナに入りたくなってきた
choice_data_list_en: ...Now I kind of want to hit the sauna.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I've scoped out pretty much every
bathhouse in
the area! There isn't a
single thing 'bout baths and
saunas the
great Inari doesn't know!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Boss, what kinda baths do ya like?
Now that
we're on the subject, I realized
I've never asked
ya.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Boss, what kinda baths do ya like?
Now that
we're on the subject, I realized
I've never asked
ya.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before we know it, Inari One and I are in
deep
conversation about baths and
saunas.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you two waiting! This way,
please!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's already our turn?! Time just
flew by!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right, now how 'bout we sample a
bowl of
Oguri's top pick?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spending the day standing in line
together, I can't
help but feel the
distance between me and Inari
One has
shrunk a little.
